piola2013-malvinas-relative-core-extent-.source_citation: Piola,A.R.,Franco,B.C.,Palma,E.D.,and Saraceno,M.(2013),Multiple jets in the Malvinas Current,JGR Oceans118,2107-2117.
piola2013-malvinas-relative-core-extent-.method: Relative geostrophic velocities referenced to deepest common level between adjacent hydrographic stations; no absolute velocity estimate.
piola2013-malvinas-relative-core-extent-.site_scope: 45.5S section,jet B near station6,about80km east of shelf break
piola2013-malvinas-relative-core-extent-.source_limits: Not absolute current bottom or uniform thickness; unobserved bottom triangles and barotropic flow remain. No source uncertainty or threshold recovered.
piola2013-malvinas-relative-core-extent-.excluded_cases: Jet A upper100m may be underestimated; jet C300-1000m is tentative. Neither is admitted. ADCP1992 is a separate section.
